_comment: Why a table can be legitimately EMPTY on a normal machine. Shown by the i button above an empty table (utils/table_sources.py::hint_for). Keys under 'tables' are SQLite table names (case-insensitive); keys under 'artifacts' are canonical artifact keys from utils/parse_status.py::ARTIFACTS and apply when a table has no entry of its own. Plain text, one or two sentences, no verdicts.

artifacts.registry: Registry tables reflect keys that exist only when the matching feature, application or user activity has occurred on this machine.
artifacts.amcache: Amcache inventory categories are filled only for the device classes, drivers and applications Windows has inventoried; many categories are empty on a typical machine.
artifacts.browser: Browser tables are filled only for browsers installed and used by a profile on this system. A browser that was never installed leaves its tables empty.
artifacts.srum: SRUM records exist only when the Diagnostic Policy Service is running and has flushed data (roughly hourly) to SRUDB.dat.
artifacts.evtx: An event log table is empty when that channel was cleared, disabled, or rolled over with no retained events.
artifacts.lnk_jumplist: LNK files and Jump Lists are written only for files and applications a user opened through the shell.
artifacts.prefetch: Prefetch is written only when the prefetcher is enabled (EnablePrefetcher > 0). It is disabled by default on Windows Server.
artifacts.recyclebin: The Recycle Bin is empty when nothing was deleted to it, it was emptied, or files were deleted with Shift+Delete.
artifacts.shimcache: ShimCache is held in memory and written to the SYSTEM hive at shutdown; a machine that has not shut down cleanly may show few entries.
artifacts.mft: MFT tables require an NTFS volume.
artifacts.usn: The USN Journal can be disabled (fsutil usn deletejournal) or be too small to retain older activity.
artifacts.mft_usn_correlation: Correlation needs both the MFT and the USN Journal to have been parsed in this case.

tables.BAM: BAM (Background Activity Moderator) exists on Windows 10 1709 and later; earlier builds and Windows Server Core may have no entries.
tables.DAM: DAM (Desktop Activity Moderator) entries are only written on connected-standby / modern-standby capable devices. Empty on most desktops.
tables.RecentDocs: RecentDocs is empty when the user never opened documents through Explorer, or when 'Show recently opened items' is disabled by policy or setting.
tables.OpenSaveMRU: Populated only when a user picked files in a common Open/Save dialog.
tables.LastSaveMRU: Populated only when a user picked a location in a common Open/Save dialog.
tables.TypedPaths: Populated only when a user typed a path into the Explorer address bar.
tables.RunMRU: Populated only when a user ran a command through Win+R.
tables.WordWheelQuery: Populated only when a user searched from the Explorer search box.
tables.Shellbags: ShellBags are written only for folders a user browsed in Explorer.
tables.UserAssist: UserAssist is written only for programs launched from the shell; it can be disabled by setting Start_TrackProgs to 0.
tables.user_shell_folders: Read from each user's Explorer\User Shell Folders key; empty only if no NTUSER.DAT hive could be read.
tables.shell_open_command: Lists shell\open\command handlers under the user's Software\Classes; most profiles register none of their own.
tables.shell_icon_overlay_identifiers: ShellIconOverlayIdentifiers holds overlay handlers installed by sync clients (OneDrive, Dropbox, Git tools); a machine without them has none.
tables.shell_service_object_delay_load: ShellServiceObjectDelayLoad is a legacy autostart key; modern Windows usually leaves it empty.
tables.MUICache: MUICache is written only for executables launched by the user.
tables.RecentApps: RecentApps existed only on some Windows 10 builds; it is empty on newer releases.
tables.RDPClientMRU: Populated only when a user connected out with the Remote Desktop client (mstsc).
tables.OfficeDocuments: Populated only when Microsoft Office is installed and a user opened documents with it.
tables.MountPoints2: Populated only when volumes or network shares were mounted for that user.
tables.NetworkShares: Empty when this machine shares no folders.
tables.USBDevices: Empty when no USB devices were ever connected.
tables.USBInstances: Empty when no USB devices were ever connected.
tables.USBProperties: Device property timestamps are not readable from a live system even when elevated; they are available from an offline SYSTEM hive.
tables.USBStorageDevices: Empty when no USB mass-storage devices were ever connected.
tables.USBStorageVolumes: Empty when no USB mass-storage volumes were ever mounted.
tables.ApplicationArtifacts: Filled only for the specific applications this parser knows about, if installed.
tables.DefenderExclusions: Empty when no Microsoft Defender exclusions are configured.
tables.image_file_execution_options: Empty when no debugger / GlobalFlag entries are set under Image File Execution Options - the normal state.
tables.appcert_dlls: AppCertDlls is empty on a normal machine.
tables.appinit_dlls: AppInit_DLLs is empty on most machines.
tables.run_services: RunServices is a legacy key that is empty on modern Windows.
tables.run_services_once: RunServicesOnce is a legacy key that is empty on modern Windows.
tables.policies_explorer_run: Empty unless a policy configures programs to run at logon.
tables.user_run_once: RunOnce entries are deleted after they run, so this is usually empty.
tables.machine_run_once: RunOnce entries are deleted after they run, so this is usually empty.
tables.windows_load_run: The legacy Windows\load and Windows\run values are empty on a normal machine.
tables.shared_task_scheduler: SharedTaskScheduler is empty on modern Windows.
tables.cached_domain_logons: Empty on a machine that never logged on to a domain, or when the SECURITY hive could not be read.
tables.lsa_secrets: Requires the SECURITY hive; empty when it could not be exported.
tables.group_policy_history: Empty on a machine that has never received domain Group Policy.
tables.printer_connections: Empty when the user never connected to a network printer.
tables.programs_cache: ProgramsCache is not populated on recent Windows releases.
tables.regedit_lastkey: Populated only when a user opened Registry Editor.
tables.registry_carved_keys: Carving only yields rows when deleted keys remain in hive slack space.
tables.registry_carved_values: Carving only yields rows when deleted values remain in hive slack space.
tables.registry_value_changes: Filled only from transaction-log replay when the hive logs held changes.
tables.AmcacheCarvedKeys: Carving only yields rows when deleted keys remain in Amcache.hve slack space.
tables.AmcacheCarvedValues: Carving only yields rows when deleted values remain in Amcache.hve slack space.
tables.InventoryApplicationAppV: Populated only when App-V applications are present.
tables.InventoryDevicePci: Not populated on all Windows builds.
tables.InventoryDeviceSensor: Populated only on devices with sensors (tablets, laptops with ambient light sensors, ...).
tables.DriverPackageExtended: Not populated on all Windows builds.
tables.srum_energy_usage: Energy usage is recorded only on battery-powered devices.
tables.srum_network_connectivity: Empty when the network connectivity provider was disabled or no networks were connected.
tables.srum_app_timeline: The App Timeline provider exists on Windows 10 and later only.
tables.SecurityLogs: Reading the Security log requires Administrator rights; also empty if the log was cleared or auditing is off.
tables.Custom_JumpLists: Custom Jump Lists are written only by applications that pin or publish tasks/destinations.
tables.deleted_entries: Empty when the journal recorded no deletions in its retained window.
tables.browser_credentials: Empty when the user never saved passwords in the browser.
tables.browser_payments: Empty when the user never saved payment methods in the browser.
tables.browser_addresses: Empty when the user never saved addresses in the browser.
tables.browser_reading_list: Empty when the reading list was never used.
tables.browser_media_history: Media History is not present in all Chromium versions.
tables.browser_gecko_history: Empty when Firefox is not installed or was never used.
tables.browser_gecko_downloads: Empty when Firefox is not installed or recorded no downloads.
tables.browser_gecko_bookmarks: Empty when Firefox is not installed.
tables.browser_gecko_cookies: Empty when Firefox is not installed.
tables.browser_gecko_formhistory: Empty when Firefox is not installed or form history was disabled.
tables.browser_gecko_credentials: Empty when Firefox is not installed or no logins were saved.
tables.browser_gecko_localstorage: Empty when Firefox is not installed.
tables.browser_gecko_sessions: Empty when Firefox is not installed.
tables.Taskband: Empty when nothing is pinned to the taskbar, or the profile never signed in interactively.
tables.BrowserHistory: TypedURLs holds only addresses typed into Internet Explorer's address bar; empty on most machines that never used IE.
tables.cid_size_mru: Populated only when a program opened a common Open/Save file dialog.
